lede: The biggest item this week is Wednesday's joint work session where the San Miguel County Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry practices, oil and gas operations, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those rules gets set. Also Wednesday, the commissioners make a rare trip to Norwood to consider a Planning Commission appointment and hear results from the Placerville Fire Survey. The Ecology Commission meets the same evening to dig into the 2022 Climate Action Plan's transportation and materials sections.

notable.stake: Commissioners appoint a Planning Commission alternate and review Placerville Fire Survey results.
Town's Climate Action Plan under review — transportation and consumption policies up for discussion.
Proposed Land Use Code changes to forestry, oil and gas, geothermal, and condo plat rules being shaped.
